summary: A shared refillable bottle needs a label that can come off before another producer uses it.
realLife: In its 2023 amendment to Maine LD 1909, the committee placed work on containers, adhesives and labels for bottles usable by different beverage manufacturers among the proposed refill activities.
gates: Two producers plan to reuse the same container across their product lines.
inGame: The bill catalog supplies the bottle-deposit question. needs: two producers plan to reuse the same container across their product lines.

turns.what: The second bottler can test its own label on the glass.
turns.pulledBy: The label comes away during the planned wash.
turns.writesBack: The pilot records the workable combination.

turns.what: The researcher asks for an alternative label material.
turns.writesBack: The next test batch carries the replacement adhesive.
